source_text: For men who have sex with men (MSM), evidence from RCTs is limited due to ethical and feasibility challenges in randomization, but a 2025 meta-analysis of observational data adjusted for confounding suggested VMMC protects primarily insertive MSM, with an adjusted odds ratio of 0.57 (95% CI 0.40-0.82) for HIV acquisition. [156]
